binaryFingerprint.format: PE32 Windows GUI Intel i386 managed .NET/Mono assembly

recoveredIlFacts.numberButtonSelectorPattern: Each normal 0-36 input handler appends/records the selected roulette result and then calls Microsoft.VisualBasic.VBMath.Randomize followed by Rnd, multiplies by 46, applies Int, adds 1 and writes the result into Form1.TextBox15.
recoveredIlFacts.form2LoadBehavior: Form2_Load copies Form1.TextBox15 into Label1 and branches on numeric selector values, populating hard-coded roulette-number sets into output text boxes.
recoveredIlFacts.selectorBranchesObserved: comparisons include 0 through 46; selector generated by normal number buttons is 1 through 46
recoveredIlFacts.repeatedNumberHandlers: Dedicated repeated-number handlers display messages such as '<n> is repeated number' and append history/state, confirming repetition tracking exists in the UI.
recoveredIlFacts.networkCaution: No active WebClient/HttpClient/WebRequest/Socket/TcpClient call was identified in the statically reviewed selected application handlers and no operational HTTP URL string was found in the binary. A generic SoapHttpClientProtocol type string exists in generated Visual Basic My.WebServices infrastructure; this audit does not treat that generic reference as evidence of casino connectivity.

secondaryDescriptions.claim: Described as selecting numbers to play over three spins.
Described as repeated-number analysis followed by numbers recommended for subsequent three-spin play.

scientificAssessment.keyRecoveredFinding: The final set-table selector reached from each ordinary number input includes an internal Visual Basic pseudo-random draw. Therefore the displayed recommendation set cannot be treated as a demonstrated deterministic extraction of the casino RNG from recent outcomes.
salvageableIdeas: freeze a recommendation before the next outcome
scientificAssessment.requiredFalsification: Reconstruct or emulate the exact recommendation sets, freeze every set before outcomes, then measure coverage and net ROI prospectively against fair RNG controls and exact target generators without cherry-picking.
